content.text: In the Philippines, digital [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-10|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-step-step|How Creators]] face a critical barrier: payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or impose restrictions that stifle growth. This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a structural lockout from global commerce. Google Apps Script, a cloud-based JavaScript platform, offers a sovereign solution. It automates order processing, payment verification, and product delivery without relying on third-party platforms. This architecture is designed for creators who need to own their infrastructure, not rent it. By leveraging free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can bypass traditional payment gates. This isn’t a workaround; it’s base-layer infrastructure built to withstand [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-which-architecture-actually-5|financial]] isolation. It’s how you reclaim control over your commerce stack.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based JavaScript platform that automates workflows directly within Google Workspace. For digital commerce, it acts as the backend logic engine, processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering product deliveries—all without Stripe, PayPal, or other intermediaries. This matters because it eliminates dependency on platforms that can arbitrarily restrict access. By integrating with NOWPayments, creators accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. The system writes order data to Google Sheets, stores files in Google Drive, and sends delivery emails via Gmail—all free, globally accessible tools. This architecture is sovereign: once deployed, COREMERCH has no access, and the creator owns every component. It’s not a patch for broken systems; it’s a complete, self-owned commerce stack designed for regions where traditional payment infrastructure fails.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The pipeline begins when a buyer sends cryptocurrency to a NOWPayments invoice. A webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, triggering Google Apps Script to process the order. The script reads the webhook data, logs the order in Google Sheets, retrieves the product file from Google Drive, and sends a delivery email via Gmail. Each step is atomic: if payment fails, the process halts. If successful, the buyer receives their product instantly. Cloudflare Workers can replace Apps Script for higher performance, with Supabase handling order storage instead of Sheets. Both configurations use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting—free, globally distributed, and immune to regional restrictions. This architecture is stateless, scalable, and decoupled from any single vendor. It’s designed to operate reliably even in environments with unstable internet or currency collapse.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions like the Philippines, where Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible or unreliable. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products but lack the tools to collect payment and deliver products securely. Traditional platforms lock them out, but this architecture unlocks sovereignty. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you deploy a complete commerce stack in 48 hours—Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and end-to-end testing included. You own the code, the data, and the process. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Just lifetime access to infrastructure you control. This isn’t a solution for those who want to tinker; it’s for those who want to deploy and dominate their market without permission.
Google Apps Script automates order processing without Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: (1) **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve the storefront and checkout pages for free. (2) **Backend Logic**: Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle order processing and payment verification. (3) **Order Storage**: Google Sheets or Supabase logs transactions securely. (4) **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores product files for instant retrieval. (5) **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. These components integrate seamlessly, forming a pipeline that requires no manual intervention. For example, a Solana transaction under $0.10 confirms in seconds, triggering the webhook that fires the script. The buyer receives their product before the confirmation email hits their inbox. Each component is replaceable, but together they form a resilient, self-owned commerce engine.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the right stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, ideal for launching quickly with up to three products. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) upgrades to Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, scaling to five products with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. Purchase your stack at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. After payment, COREMERCH deploys your infrastructure within 48 hours, loads your products, and hands over full ownership. You receive a deployment guide, source code, and 30-day support. To maintain sovereignty, use recommended low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions. Monitor your Google Sheets or Supabase dashboard for orders, and let the automated pipeline handle the rest. This isn’t a tutorial—it’s a turnkey deployment of infrastructure you own.

Creators own the entire stack after deployment, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never written code before?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, and COREMERCH provides a deployment guide. You don’t need to write code to operate the system, but understanding the architecture helps you maintain control.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime, but if it fails, orders pause until service resumes. The system is stateless, so no data is lost. You can also switch to another crypto payment gateway if needed.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are manual. Since you control the wallet, you can send crypto directly to the buyer. The system logs all transactions in Google Sheets or Supabase for easy reference.
Can I scale this beyond five products?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack supports up to five products out of the box, but the architecture scales indefinitely. Use the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for documentation on expanding your stack.
What if I need to change hosting providers?
The stack is decoupled, so you can replace GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages with any static hosting provider. COREMERCH provides the source code, so you retain full portability.
